dcuniverse.msg.canalizando: Finish the ability before transforming back
dcuniverse.msg.energia_esgotada: Out of energy! Powers locked until 10% is back
dcuniverse.guia.passos.intro: This guide follows you through the DC Universe. Each task on the right gets checked on its own once you do it.
dcuniverse.guia.passos.teclas: G opens the guide and H transforms you back (Options > Controls).
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.transformar.desc: Use the Crystal of the House of El.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.sol.desc: Stand under the open sky by day.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.voar.desc: Press jump twice in the air.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.estrondo.desc: Fly forward while sprinting (Ctrl) until the boom.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.manobra.desc: While flying, double-tap A, D, S or W.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.destransformar.de: Press H or use the crystal.
dcuniverse.guia.personagens.vazio: No characters available on this server.
dcuniverse.guia.personagem.como_descobri: To discover this character, carry their transformation item, transform into them or see another player transformed.
dcuniverse.guia.recarga.sunlight: +%s per second in sunlight or near a Solar Chamber
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.flight: Flies: jump twice in the air; Ctrl speeds up; double-tap A/D to roll, S to turn around, W to dash
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.glide: Jumping in the air opens the cape to glide (jump again closes it)
item.dcuniverse.cristal_superman: Crystal of the House of El
personagem.dcuniverse.superman.exp: Absolute strength and power: you are the strongest person in the world, and the world must be handled with care.
dcuniverse.guia.passos.fim: You finished the First Steps! New tasks show up here as the mod grows.
dcuniverse.hud.demo.inicio: HUD demo: for 90 seconds a sample supreme appears on the HUD and is used by itself 4 seconds after it gets ready.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.radial.desc: Hold R and release over one.
dcuniverse.radial.vazio: This character has no abilities yet.
dcuniverse.guia.ficha.unidades: Health and damage in hearts; running, flight and gliding in blocks per second.
dcuniverse.guia.voo.detalhe: Cruise %s b/s. Holding Ctrl (boost) speed keeps rising up to %s b/s and the trail shows. The dash costs %s energy.
dcuniverse.guia.planar.detalhe: Cruise %s b/s with the cape open; curving down it reaches %s b/s and diving (Shift) %s b/s. Release Shift while fast to pull up into the sky. S brakes like a parachute, A/D turn, double-tap A/D barrel-rolls sideways (dodge) and double-tap W beats the cape for a boost that costs %s energy. Landing fast turns into a roll, with no fall damage.
dcuniverse.guia.hab.impacto: Explodes on impact: hits everything within %s blocks for half damage
habilidade.dcuniverse.visao_de_calor.des: Heat beams shoot from your eyes while you hold V. They burn enemies, light fires, campfires, candles, TNT and furnaces (no fuel needed) and melt every kind of ice and snow.
habilidade.dcuniverse.sopro_congelante.d: A cone of freezing air. It slows enemies, traps anyone caught in it for 1 s inside a block of ice, turns water into ice and lava into obsidian and puts out fires.
habilidade.dcuniverse.soco_sonico.desc: A punch so fast it releases a shockwave. It travels in a straight line and explodes on impact, throwing everything around it.
personagem.dcuniverse.superman.lore: Kal-El was born on Krypton, a planet on the brink of destruction. Just before the end, his father, Jor-El, sent him to Earth in a small ship. Raised by Jonathan and Martha Kent on a Smallville farm as Clark Kent, he discovered that the yellow sun gave him powers far beyond those of any human. Today he is a reporter at the Daily Planet in Metropolis and, in a red cape, protects the world as Superman, Earth's greatest hero.
dcuniverse.msg.sem_chao: You need to be near the ground
habilidade.dcuniverse.pisao_sismico.desc: A stomp so strong it cracks the ground. The shockwave runs out in a ring from you, throws enemies up and away and slows them all. It tears up the grass on its way. You must be on or very close to the ground.
habilidade.dcuniverse.visao_raio_x.desc: You see through blocks: ores, chests and monster spawners are marked in color and mobs get an outline, even behind walls. Only you see it.
habilidade.dcuniverse.fortaleza_da_solid: A Kryptonian crystal raises a crystal fortress from the ground where you aim, with its door facing you. Inside, the solar chamber heals every player and recharges the energy of anyone transformed, and monsters are pushed out. Allies can come in and use it. At the end it shatters and vanishes.
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.super_strength: Super strength: breaks stone and ore by hand
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.super_jump: Super jump: crouch and hold jump
dcuniverse.guia.salto.detalhe: Hold crouch and jump on the ground to charge (full charge in %2$s s) and release jump: up to about %1$s blocks high.
dcuniverse.guia.ricochete.detalhe: Arrows and other projectiles of up to %s ♥ deal no damage.
dcuniverse.guia.hab.cura: Inside: Regeneration %s and +%s energy per second
dcuniverse.guia.recarga.kryptonite: %s per second near kryptonite or carrying it, and loses super strength and ricochet
dcuniverse.guia.item.bloco_kryptonita: Nine shards packed together. Its aura weakens Kryptonians within 10 blocks: a good base defense in multiplayer.
dcuniverse.guia.item.camara_solar: Focuses sunlight into a crystal. Kryptonians within 6 blocks recharge as if under the sun, even at night or underground.
dcuniverse.guia.item.cristal_kryptoniano: A crystal from Krypton that came inside the meteor. Ingredient of the Crystal of the House of El and the Solar Chamber.
One per Meteor Crater, in the chest hidden inside the meteor at the bottom of the crater.
dcuniverse.guia.item.cristal_superman: Right-click to put on Superman's suit and gain his powers. Press H to turn back to normal.
dcuniverse.guia.item.fragmento_alienigen: A piece of the meteor veined with energy. Used to craft another Hero's Guide and, in future versions, alien technology.
In the meteor chest at the bottom of Meteor Craters (2 to 4 per chest).
dcuniverse.guia.item.fragmento_kryptonit: A shard of kryptonite. Carrying one drains Superman's energy, gives Weakness and removes super strength.
Mine Kryptonite Ore (Fortune increases the amount) or break a Block of Kryptonite back into 9.
dcuniverse.guia.item.guia_heroi: This book. Right-click it or press G to open the tasks, the characters and every mod item with its recipe.
dcuniverse.guia.item.guia_heroi.obter: Every player gets one when joining the world for the first time.
dcuniverse.guia.item.minerio_kryptonita: Green alien rock that glows in the dark. A transformed Superman loses energy and super strength within 6 blocks of it.
Underground from Y -60 to 0, and exposed in Meteor Craters. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better; Silk Touch drops the ore itself.
dcuniverse.guia.item.nucleo_meta_1: An energy core that awakens powers. Tier I: base of early-game transformation items and of Core II.
dcuniverse.guia.item.nucleo_meta_2: Tier II, with diamond and glowstone dust: base of tier 2 transformation items and of Core III.
dcuniverse.guia.item.nucleo_meta_3: Tier III, with blaze rod, ender pearl and amethyst: base of tier 3 transformation items and of Core IV.
dcuniverse.guia.item.nucleo_meta_4: Tier IV, the strongest, with netherite and echo from the Ancient City: base of end-game transformation items such as Superman's. Does not burn in lava.
dcuniverse.guia.item.tecido_tatico: Tough fabric with a kevlar weave. The base of every hero suit.
dcuniverse.guia.itens.abrir: Click to open in the guide
dcuniverse.guia.itens.sem_uso: Not an ingredient of anything yet.
personagem.dcuniverse.batman.lore: As a boy, Bruce Wayne watched his parents die in a Gotham alley. Heir to a fortune, he spent years travelling the world to train body and mind: martial arts, criminology, chemistry, engineering and the art of vanishing. Back in Gotham, he took up the symbol of the bat so that criminals would feel the same fear he felt that night. He has no superpowers: he wins because he prepares better than anyone, with the utility belt, the gadgets built in the Batcave and the vehicles made with Lucius Fox's help.
habilidade.dcuniverse.gancho.desc: Fires the grapnel where you aim. On a block, the cable pulls you there; hold jump as you arrive to be launched upward. On a small mob, it pulls the mob to you; on a big mob, it pulls you to it. Aim at the Batwing to board it. Use again or sneak to let go. No fall damage while the cable is attached.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batarangue.desc: Throws a batarang that follows your aim, ricochets to the nearest mobs and comes back to your hand. On the way it cuts cobwebs, leaves, vines, tripwires and leads (freeing the leashed mob), presses buttons and pulls levers. Briefly slows the target.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batarangue_explosi: A batarang with an explosive charge: it blows up on the first mob or block it hits, hurting and pushing everything around without breaking blocks.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batarangue_eletric: A batarang with a battery: the shock paralyzes the target and arcs to up to 2 nearby mobs.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batwing.desc: The Batwing dives from the sky and stops beside you, and you board it. Fly with W (throttle), Ctrl (afterburner), S (brake and hover), A/D and the mouse. Hold left click to fire the guns (watch the heat), right click fires a homing missile at the target locked in your sights and V turns on stealth mode, which makes mobs lose track of you. Sneak to jump out; another player can board as a passenger. The grapnel also gets you back on board.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batmovel.desc: The Batmobile roars down the street and stops beside you (with no clear path it rolls out of a smoke cloud right there) and you board it. W accelerates, S brakes and reverses, A/D steer, Ctrl fires the turbo and Space pulls the handbrake to drift. Hold left click for the guns, right click launches a roof missile at the locked target and V electrifies the hull, shocking anyone close. Running enemies over hurts. Sneak to get out; a passenger rides in the other seat.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batmoto.desc: The Batcycle arrives at full throttle and you mount it. It is the fastest and most agile on the ground: W accelerates, S brakes, A/D lean into the turns, Ctrl fires the turbo and Space makes it jump. Hold left click for the guns, right click throws batarangs forward and V drops a smoke screen behind you that blinds whoever is chasing. Sneak to get off; a passenger rides on the back.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batbarco.desc: The Batboat surfaces near you (it needs deep water nearby) and you board it. On the surface it planes fast: W accelerates, S brakes, A/D turn and Ctrl fires the turbo. V dives and surfaces: underwater it follows your aim up and down, Space rises and you don't drown. Hold left click for the guns and right click fires a torpedo at the locked target. On land it barely crawls. Sneak to get out.
dcuniverse.msg.sem_cargas: %s: out of charges, the belt is making more
dcuniverse.msg.disruptor_sem_alvo: Disruptor: nothing to disarm in your sights
dcuniverse.guia.recarga.tech_station: +%s per second near a Batcomputer or Tech Charger, or while flying the Batwing; there gadgets recharge 3x faster
dcuniverse.guia.hab.cargas: Charges: %s. The belt makes 1 every %s s using %s energy
dcuniverse.guia.hab.ricochete: Ricochets to up to %s mobs and comes back
dcuniverse.guia.hab.choque: The shock arcs to up to 2 nearby mobs
dcuniverse.guia.hab.batwing.voo: Flies at %s blocks/s, %s blocks/s with afterburner
dcuniverse.guia.hab.batwing.armas: Guns: %s ♥ per shot up to %s blocks. Missiles: %s, %s ♥ each with a %s block radius, a new one every %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.velocidade: Drives at %s blocks/s, %s blocks/s with turbo
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.armas.batmov: Guns: %s ♥ per shot up to %s blocks. Roof missiles: %s, %s ♥ each, a new one every %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.armas.batmot: Guns: %s ♥ per shot up to %s blocks. Batarangs: %s, %s ♥ each, a new one every %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.armas.batbar: Guns: %s ♥ per shot up to %s blocks. Torpedoes: %s, %s ♥ each, a new one every %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.atropelo: Runs enemies over from %s blocks/s: up to %s ♥ at top speed
dcuniverse.guia.hab.veiculo.especial.bat: Electric hull: %2$s ♥ and %3$s s of stun within %1$s blocks, every %4$s s
Smoke screen of %1$s blocks for %5$s s, every %4$s s
Dives and sails underwater at %6$s blocks/s without drowning
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.gancho.desc: As Batman, aim at a high block and press V.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.batarangue.desc: It comes back to your hand on its own.
dcuniverse.radial.sem_cargas: Out of charges: next in %s s
personagem.dcuniverse.batman.exp: Preparation, gear and strategy: you win because you planned, not because you are stronger.
dcuniverse.guia.item.cinto_batman: Right-click to put on Batman's suit and carry his gadgets. Press H to turn back to normal.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.planar.desc: As Batman, press jump in the air.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.manobra_planar.de: While gliding, double-tap A, D or W, or dive with Shift and let go.
habilidade.dcuniverse.modo_detetive.desc: The cowl's visor analyzes everything around you. Press V to turn it on and again to turn it off. While on, you see mobs through walls (threats in red, others in blue, players in orange), each threat's weak point and health, other players' footprints, doors, levers, buttons, pressure plates and chests, and weak walls (cracked bricks and infested blocks) that explosive gel brings down. Hits and batarangs deal extra damage to mobs while it is on. Drains energy per second (none in creative) and turns itself off when it runs out.
habilidade.dcuniverse.bomba_fumaca.desc: Bursts a dense cloud of smoke at your feet. Anyone inside is blinded and slowed, and mobs lose sight of you, even those outside that were aiming at you. You get a few seconds of speed and invisibility to vanish.
habilidade.dcuniverse.gel_explosivo.desc: Aim at a nearby block and press V to spread a gel charge on the wall. Sneak and press V (or press while aiming at nothing) to detonate: each charge beeps and blows in sequence, opening a round hole and hurting and pushing anyone nearby. Every broken block drops as an item; obsidian and bedrock never break.
habilidade.dcuniverse.batarangue_congela: A batarang with a nitrogen capsule: the target is trapped in a block of ice for 3 s (players and bosses are only slowed) and nearby fire goes out. Over water it freezes its path and the impact point into ice that melts on its own: you can cross a river running after it.
On impact (or at the end of its range) it releases a 6-block sonic pulse: everyone around is stunned, slowed and weakened, and mobs lose sight of you. Bats, silverfish and endermites take far more damage, and nearby glass shatters. It does not come back.
habilidade.dcuniverse.lancador_rede.desc: Fires a net that opens in the air. On a hit it wraps the target in real cobwebs and holds it for 6 s. On a wall or the floor it becomes a 3x3 cobweb trap for 15 s. The webs vanish on their own and drop no string.
habilidade.dcuniverse.disruptor.desc: An electronic pulse at your crosshair, up to 32 blocks. The target is shocked and paralyzed for 2 s and disarmed: the weapon in a mob's hand (bow, crossbow, trident, sword or axe) burns out, and a creeper loses its fuse for 10 s. Lit TNT near the crosshair goes out and drops as a block. With nothing to disarm, no charge is spent.
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.stealth: Stealth: sneaking in the dark, mobs only notice you up close
dcuniverse.guia.passiva.counter: Counter: sneak (or raise your shield) right as a hit comes to cancel it and strike back
dcuniverse.guia.furtividade.detalhe: Works at light level %s or less; mobs see you %s%% less far. The screen edges darken while you are hidden
dcuniverse.guia.contra.detalhe: %s s window before the hit. Strikes back for %s ♥, stuns for %s s and knocks back; projectiles fly back at the shooter. Mistimed: wait %s s
dcuniverse.guia.hab.dreno: Drains %s energy per second while on. Weak points: +%s%% damage to mobs
dcuniverse.guia.hab.fumaca: Blinds those inside for %s s; you get %s s of speed and invisibility
dcuniverse.guia.hab.gel: Up to %s charges placed at once. Sneak and press V to detonate
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.detetive.desc: As Batman, pick it in the menu and press V.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.gel.desc: Aim at a nearby wall and press V.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.contra_ataque.des: Sneak right as a mob is about to hit you.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.furtivo.desc: Sneaking in the dark, stay near a monster without it seeing you.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.dica: Click the card to choose it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.escolhi: This is the one your supreme calls.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.batwing: Flies over everything, hovers and fires homing missiles. Stealth mode drops off the mobs' radar.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.batmove: Heavy and tough: drifts on the handbrake, runs enemies over, fires roof missiles and electrifies its hull.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.batmoto: The fastest on the ground: jumps, leans into turns, throws batarangs and drops smoke behind it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.garagem.batbarc: Planes over water and dives to sail underwater. Fires torpedoes. Needs deep water nearby.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.gadgets.sem_her: No tech suit detected. Put on the Utility Belt and the Batcomputer will refill your gadgets and energy at once. The other tabs work for anyone.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.gadgets.dica: Pick a slot, then click a gadget
dcuniverse.batcomputador.gadgets.vazio.d: Click a gadget in the arsenal to store it here. Click the gadget already in the slot (or right-click the pouch) to remove it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.gadgets.sem_cin: No hero with a utility belt in this world.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.analise.falta: Not enough data. Carry a sample (%s) and analyze it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.mapa.alcance: %s-block radius, from what your eyes have already loaded.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.zombie: Slow and tough; burns in daylight. Also covers drowned, husks and zombie villagers.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.skeleton: Archer: close the distance or use cover. Burns in daylight. Covers strays and bogged.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.spider: Climbs walls and only attacks in the dark. Covers the poisonous cave spider.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.creeper: Explodes up close: hit and back off. Lightning makes it charged and far stronger.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.enderman: Teleports and hates eye contact. Water hurts it: fight in the rain or near water.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.slime: Splits when it dies. Take out the small ones first or stay up high.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.phantom: Hunts those who skip sleep. Burns in daylight; sleeping prevents it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.guardian: Slow-charging laser: break line of sight. Covers the elder guardian.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.zombifie: Neutral until attacked, then the whole pack comes. Avoid stray hits.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.magma_cu: Immune to fire and lava. Jumps high and splits like a slime.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.blaze: Ranged fireballs. Snowballs and water hurt it; immune to fire.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.ghast: Fragile but far away. Hit its fireball back at it.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.breeze: Deflects projectiles and fires wind charges. Melee works best.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.wither_s: Its hits inflict Wither. Tall: a 2-block gap keeps it out.
dcuniverse.batcomputador.dossie.shulker: Shots that make you levitate. Strike when its shell opens.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.capa_planador.des: Put the cape on your chest and jump in midair to glide.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.visor_tatico.desc: Keep the visor on your head for 10 s.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.cinto.desc: At the Batcomputer, Gadgets tab: swap a gadget into a slot.
dcuniverse.guia.tarefa.garagem.desc: At the Batcomputer, Garage tab: pick another vehicle and call it with the supreme.
dcuniverse.guia.item.batarangue_simples: Throwable that comes back to your hand (2 damage). Anyone can use it: it cuts webs and leaves and presses buttons from afar. It returns to your inventory, or drops if you miss the catch.
dcuniverse.guia.item.batcomputador: Batman's command center. Gadgets: refills the belt and energy at once (every 60 s). Fabricate: makes tech parts straight from your inventory. Analysis: a mob sample reveals its file and you deal +15% damage to that type. Map: the terrain around with threats and players. It is also a recharge station.
dcuniverse.guia.item.capa_planador: Wear it on your chest to glide like Batman: jump in midair to open it, dive to gain speed and pull up to climb. Double-tap W for a boost that tires you (costs hunger); double-tap A/D to roll and hold S to brake.
dcuniverse.guia.item.carregador_tecnolog: Recharge station: tech heroes nearby regain energy faster and the belt makes charges 3 times quicker. Use the Tactical Visor or the Grappling Hook on it to recharge them (costs 1 redstone).
dcuniverse.guia.item.componente_tecnolog: Mechanical and electronic part that builds gadgets, the Batcomputer and the Utility Belt.
dcuniverse.guia.item.gancho_escalada: Batman's grapple without powers: right-click fires up to 30 blocks and pulls you there; click again to let go. Each shot uses 1 of 200 uses, and it recharges at the Tech Charger.
dcuniverse.guia.item.lingote_prometio: Nearly indestructible metal, the base of heavy tech: energy cores today, top-tier armor later.
dcuniverse.guia.item.lingote_prometio.ob: Smelt Promethium Ore in a furnace or, twice as fast, in a blast furnace.
dcuniverse.guia.item.minerio_prometio: Rare ore from the bottom of the world, locked in deepslate. It glows faintly in the dark and only drops with a diamond pickaxe.
dcuniverse.guia.item.minerio_prometio.ob: Mine deepslate between Y -60 and -30, in small veins of 1 to 3 blocks (very rare).
dcuniverse.guia.item.nucleo_energia: Promethium battery that stores plenty of energy. Powers the Tech Charger and energy armors.
dcuniverse.guia.item.placa_circuito: The brain of every device. It also repairs the Tactical Visor at an anvil.
dcuniverse.guia.item.visor_tatico: Tactical helmet: night vision and hostile mobs within 24 blocks outlined in red, with a threat count on screen. A charge lasts 30 minutes of use; recharge it at the Tech Charger or repair it with a Circuit Board.
